title: webui.json
description: Settings of the sing-box config generator. Flat since version 2: the profile level and the `defaults` object were removed (see techdocs/architecture.md §8.9). A version-1 file is migrated once by the editor.

version.description: Schema version, bumped only on incompatible changes. 1 was the profile-level form; 2 is flat.

note.description: Free-form comment carried over from settings.yaml. Ignored by the core.

sources.description: Provider folders under the sources root (GATEHOUSE_SOURCES, default <dir of webui.json>/sources). The folder name IS the provider name; a folder may hold links.txt, tunnel configs (*.conf), or both.

type.description: Kept in sync with PROXY_TYPES of errors.mjs; a test guards the drift.

servers.description: Server tags. An empty or missing list means auto-select. A single string is accepted and normalised by the core, exactly as in the reference.

note.description: Free-form comment. Ignored by the core.

pinned.description: The exit of this proxy is fixed on purpose. Ignored by the core; enforced by the model: a pinned proxy may name at most one server.

watch.description: The watchdog checks this proxy's inbound and may act on it. Ignored by the core.

watch_url.description: Per-proxy check target. Empty means the neutral default (generate_204). Ignored by the core.

routes.description: Domain routes layered on top of the proxies. Route names carry the same restriction as before: a name made of digits only would be reordered by JavaScript object key rules and would break the byte-for-byte match with the reference.

note.description: Free-form comment. Ignored by the core: buildRules reads only outbound and domains.

clash_api.description: External HTTP API of the daemon (Clash-compatible). Off by default; disabled means config.json stays byte-identical to the reference. The secret is NEVER stored here: it comes from GATEHOUSE_API_SECRET.

controller.description: external_controller, host:port. Only 127.0.0.1 is accepted; anything else is refused by the generator.

watchdog.description: Liveness watchdog of the editor. Read-only for the watchdog itself: it never writes webui.json or config.json.

enabled.description: Global switch. With it off a proxy marked watch is not checked at all.

failures_before_action.description: Consecutive failed checks before the first rung. Two by default.

pause_seconds.description: Minimum pause between two actions on one proxy.

max_restarts_per_day.description: After this many restarts the watchdog gives up until the owner resets it.

restart_enabled.description: Second rung: restart the daemon. Off by default until the owner confirms it helps.
